replies.author: goldenwalrus909
replies.body: Dude, this map is super creative and original! I really like it! I think there is one problem, though: the team who gets to the middle and gets the diamonds first can kill-farm the crap out of the other team. I think it would be a good idea to make some more islands in the middle which can also help with the void problem. Also, an island or two near spawn with iron could be really helpful and make all those diamonds less OP. Amazing map, nevertheless! :D

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
It doesn't really seem to have enough space for decent PvP to develop on... the middle islands are just too close to eachother, there isn't space to tunnel which would make the monuments even harder to get taking in consideration they're too close to eachother and too close to spawn.

Try improving your map, adding different levels, more rooms, space for pvp, relocate monuments... You should make an xbox/nintendo containing a monument, the spawn could have different levels/floors (perhaps some iron blocks that could be both decoration and to mine). You can do many things with your current idea!
I wish you good luck with your map! ^_^
